release_notes:
1. Critical Hotfix (PHP 8 / Smarty Compatibility): Resolved 500 Internal Server Error caused by PHP 8 incompatible Smarty modifier invocation on active destinations tooltip.
2. Backend Pre-computation: Pre-formatted active destination names into server-side string properties avoiding runtime template helper failures.
3. Defensive Exception Guard: Wrapped Back Office module configuration and template compilation in comprehensive try-catch Throwable boundaries with detailed diagnostic logging.
